conflicts.topic: Annual household income ceiling for CMCHIS eligibility
conflicts.source_a: Secondary source describing CMCHIS eligibility (aggregator content, not myScheme itself)
conflicts.claim_a: Household annual income must be below approximately Rs. 72,000/year.
conflicts.source_b: Secondary sources (multiple aggregators) describing CMCHIS eligibility
conflicts.claim_b: Household annual income must be below approximately Rs. 1,20,000/year.
conflicts.recommended_action: Contact the Tamil Nadu CMCHIS administering office (or locate the current Government Order / official cmchistn.gov.in page) to confirm the exact, current income ceiling before encoding it as a hard rule threshold. Until resolved, R_CMCHIS_003.value is intentionally set to null.

conflicts.topic: Nodal department and income-ceiling exception for differently-abled persons
conflicts.claim_a: CMCHIS is attributed to the Planning, Development and Special Initiatives Department, with an income ceiling applying to general economically-weaker-section families.
conflicts.claim_b: A similarly-named scheme is attributed to the Department for Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, covering differently-abled persons and their families with NO income ceiling.
conflicts.recommended_action: Determine whether these are (a) the same scheme with a special-category exception, or (b) two distinct schemes that happen to share a name, by checking Tamil Nadu Government Orders or contacting the Department for Welfare of Differently Abled Persons directly.

conflicts.topic: Number and list of CGHS-covered (notified) cities
conflicts.claim_a: CGHS operates in approximately 25-26 notified cities (explicit list provided, e.g., Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Bengaluru, etc., as of 2015-16).
conflicts.claim_b: CGHS serves approximately 42 lakh beneficiaries across approximately 80 cities as of 2026.
conflicts.recommended_action: The 2015-16 city list (SRC004) should be treated as a floor, not a ceiling. Before using R_CGHS_002 to reject a user's city, cross-check the CURRENT city list on cghs.mohfw.gov.in (SRC008), which could not be automatically fetched in this research pass.

conflicts.topic: Minimum number of employees required for an establishment to be covered under ESI
conflicts.claim_a: Covers employees of factories/establishments with 10 or more employees in notified districts (no state-wise variation mentioned).
conflicts.source_b: Multiple secondary/aggregator sources (not independently verified against an ESIC circular in this pass)
conflicts.claim_b: The threshold is 20 or more employees in certain states, specifically Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Odisha, and Chandigarh.
conflicts.recommended_action: Confirm the current state-wise establishment-size threshold against an official ESIC notification/circular before encoding state-specific values into R_ESIC_003.

conflicts.topic: Total number of medical/surgical procedures covered under the 70+ expansion
conflicts.source_a: Ministry press statement (approx. Dec 2024, reflected in SRC002's underlying reporting window)
conflicts.recommended_action: Treat any specific procedure-count figure as approximate and time-sensitive; do not hardcode a precise number into user-facing benefit text without checking the current Health Benefit Package (HBP) list on pmjay.gov.in.
